title: mm.worker/2 job input
description: The `input` of a RunPod job for the metamusic worker (C321). Mirrored by provider.ParseWorkerInput (Go, contract mm.worker/2) and mmworker.contract.parse_input (Python); tests keep the three in agreement. Limits the schema cannot state (the decoded size of all attachments, the /run body) are checked by the parsers only. mm-worker-1.*.schema.json are unchanged.

fallback_after_s.description: Reserved (C321.3): the worker ignores it until it advertises capability fallback.
